note: After the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), itself adapted from the original description of Holmgren & Holmgren 1917 and the redescription of Roonwal & Sen-Sarma (1960); the alate, soldier and pseudoworker are all described and measured, and the type specimens were examined. In the original the alate 'body length without wings' is OCR-read as 1.1-9.1 mm, which is inconsistent with 14.0—15.0 mm with wings; it should be a value such as 7.1—9.1 mm, so that figure is not recorded here.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and body dorsum brown; pronotum slightly paler; antennal apex pale brown, darker near the tip; sternites pale yellow. Head and body moderately hairy. Body length (with wings) 14.0—15.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular, width including compound eyes slightly greater than length to mandible base (length 1.30—1.48, width 1.55—1.70 mm); Y suture weak or absent. Compound eyes medium-sized (maximum diameter 0.45—0.55 mm), subcircular. Ocelli oval, translucent, touching the compound eyes, maximum diameter 0.17—0.25 mm. Antennae 18-segmented; segment 3 shortest; segments 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus subrectangular, shorter than in other species, with 2 pairs of hairs anteriorly; anteclypeus subtrapezoidal, transparent, longer than the postclypeus. Labrum subsquare, anterior margin rounded, length 0.30—0.50, width 0.55—0.65 mm. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum subrectangular, almost as wide as the head including compound eyes (length 0.90—0.99, width 1.57—1.70 mm); anterior margin rather incurved, without a median notch; sides rounded; posterior margin nearly straight, weakly incurved medially. Wings transparent, weakly nodulate. Fore wing 11.7—12.15 mm long; venation largely as in the genus, the subcosta joining the costa beyond the wing scale, the radius reaching the middle of the wing or beyond, the radial sector with 5—7 branches reaching the costa—subcosta, the media with about 12 cross-veins to the radial sector, the media and cubitus reticulate between them, the cubitus with 10 branches reaching the posterior margin. Hind wing radius joining the subcosta—costa slightly beyond the middle of the wing, radial sector with 6 branches, media arising from the radial sector at the proximal fifth of the wing, cubitus with 14 branches. Abdomen slender, hairy; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae and labrum brownish; mandibles black, red-brown at the base; pronotum paler than the head, deep straw-coloured; body paler than the pronotum. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 10.0—10.7 mm. Head capsule broadly subrectangular, width from two-thirds to more than three-quarters of the length to mandible base (length 2.88—3.5, width 2.0—2.46 mm); anterolateral corners acute and projecting; frons sloping forwards at 45°, with a median depression extending back to the occiput; Y suture present but inconspicuous; posterior margin rounded. Compound eyes whitish, oval, maximum diameter 0.20—0.30 mm, more than one long diameter from the antennae. Ocelli absent. Antennae 15-segmented; antennal ridges weak; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus rectangular, deeper and slightly inflated, each side of the anterior margin with 1 hair; anteclypeus thin and narrow, whitish, band-like. Labrum subrectangular, anterior margin rounded; length 0.25—0.30, width 0.42—0.54 mm. Mandibles short and stout, basal swelling weak; length 1.62—1.71 mm; mandible length/head length index 0.48—0.59. Left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2. Postmentum long, club-shaped, with more hairs than in other species; club bilobed; waist long but not very narrow; length 1.83—2.10, maximum width 0.72—0.80, waist width 0.30—0.42 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, sides rounded; anterior margin rather to strongly incurved and with a median notch, posterior margin convex and medially concave; distinctly narrower than the head (length 1.0—1.34, width 1.90—2.22 mm). Legs long and slender, hind femur more inflated than in other species, each tibia with 3 spurs; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen slender, each tergite with a row of hairs along its posterior margin; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule deep straw-coloured; labrum, antennae and pronotum distinctly paler; abdomen whitish. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 7.5—9.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular, width almost equal to length to mandible base (length 1.7—1.8, width 1.9—2.0 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 longer than segments 4 and 5 together; segment 2 longer than segment 3. Postclypeus subrectangular, with 2 pairs of hairs anteriorly; anteclypeus trapezoidal, whitish, longer than the postclypeus. Labrum subsquare, anterior margin and surface with short hairs. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum subrectangular, narrower than the head; anterior margin concave, posterior margin weakly convex, sides rounded; length 0.8—0.9, width 1.5—1.8 mm. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
